summary: The Ghana Immigration Service's eVisa portal lists ECOWAS and AES nationals as visa-free, although its ETA Applicant Guide places ECOWAS states under the ETA regime. Nationals of African Union member states and of countries with a bilateral visa waiver agreement with Ghana apply online for Ghana's free ETA. Other nationalities need an eVisa (USD 260, up to 60 days) from the Ghana Immigration Service portal or a visa from a Ghanaian embassy.

tips.text: The Ghana Immigration Service's ETA Applicant Guide says the ETA regime applies to nationals of all African Union member states, all ECOWAS member states and countries holding a current bilateral visa waiver agreement with Ghana, and that the ETA is free.

The Ghana Immigration Service says to use the official eligibility checker on evisa.immigration.gov.gh before starting an application: it tells you whether your passport needs an eVisa, an ETA or nothing at all.

Carry your yellow fever certificate. The Ghana Immigration Service says it is required for entry and may be checked at the port of entry, and that travellers without one may be referred to airport health officials, including for vaccination.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Ghana?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. The Ghana Immigration Service's eVisa portal lists ECOWAS and AES nationals as visa-free, although its ETA Applicant Guide places ECOWAS states under the ETA regime. Nationals of African Union member states and of countries with a bilateral visa waiver agreement with Ghana apply for the free ETA. Other nationalities, including the US, UK and EU, need a visa: an eVisa from the Ghana Immigration Service portal (USD 260, up to 60 days) or a visa from a Ghanaian embassy or high commission.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for Ghana?
faq.answer: Yes. US passport holders need a visa before travel. They can apply online for a Ghana eVisa on the Ghana Immigration Service portal: USD 260 with standard processing within 96 hours, single entry, a stay of up to 60 days (the immigration officer sets it on arrival), valid 90 days from issue. The Embassy of Ghana in Washington also issues visas.

faq.question: Is Ghana visa-free for African passport holders?
faq.answer: The Ghana Immigration Service's eVisa portal lists ECOWAS and AES nationals as visa-free and gives no length of stay; its ETA Applicant Guide, however, places ECOWAS states under the ETA regime. Nationals of the other African Union member states apply online for the free ETA before travel; the guide gives a maximum stay of 90 days from the date of entry.

faq.question: Can I get a visa on arrival in Ghana?
faq.answer: The Ghana Immigration Service's visa on arrival is the Emergency Entry Visa (USD 200). GIS says it may be granted to a person who appears before an immigration officer without a visa, subject to conditions, and that the application is a letter to the Comptroller-General of Immigration with the host's and the guest's passport bio pages.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever vaccination for Ghana?
faq.answer: Yes. The Ghana Immigration Service says a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate is required for entry into Ghana and may be checked at the port of entry.
